proposed: From a rooftop, the Silver Samurai watches Magneto's blackout strike the world.
changes.evidence: The X-Men '97 #8 location list has the Silver Samurai (cameo) in Tokyo, Japan. This is the episode where Magneto sets off the worldwide blackout.

owner_calls.question: The pin is at [-56, -68.5], which is in the Drake Passage south of Cape Horn, about 700 km north of the Antarctic coast. The region line says Antarctica. Is that a stand-in because the Earth map is cut off before Antarctica, or should the pin move onto the continent?
options: Keep [-56, -68.5] as a stand-in and say so in the note
Move the pin onto Antarctica (e.g. [-75, -70]) if the map shows that far south
owner_calls.evidence: The Savage Land is a tropical preserve hidden in Antarctica. In X-Men '97 #17 it appears as the Acolytes' base in Antarctica. No other place in the data has a latitude below -60.
